subject: prd/feature-brainstorm
statement: If If the record has been hand-edited between turns into a form the template contract cannot parse, then the system shall surface a named defect (section, entry, reason, remedy) and continue from the last parseable state — never silently discard or rewrite the operator's edit
intent: a named defect and a proposed fix to confirm
fit_criterion: on the invalid-edit fixture, the defect names section + reason and the operator's text is preserved verbatim in the record
